cases.purpose: Preserve offered values and distinguish stale/new game openings
cases.initialState: Exact mock projections and pending callback identities in tests/mechanics_client_model.lua
actions: Present an empty actionable array
Enrich current/printing values
Submit boolean false and each offered response category
Adopt a replacement game with reused prompt ID
Deliver old failure/success/concession callbacks
Present explicit stop-request metadata
expected: No visibility-derived actionability
No native value rewriting
No duplicate pending action
No stale game adoption or latch clearing
No inferred thread termination or game outcome

cases.purpose: Keep concession independent of a blocked ordinary request without changing action order or room ownership
cases.initialState: Owned HTTP fault server: state/action delay1.5s, refused/invalid/dropped responses; no native game
actions: Queue a slow state response then request concession
Change practice native game ID before an old state response
Concede through authenticated-shaped room route
Attempt practice stop while in room
Queue a slow ordinary action then request concession
Drop response after synthetic HTTP acceptance
expected: Control latency under0.7s before ordinary response
Old-generation response rejected
Room route retains expected game and practice stop refused
No automatic retry of uncertain accepted action

cases.purpose: Preserve independent P/T, counters, tapped, damage, colors and abilities through crowded rendering
cases.initialState: 1000 exact synthetic object IDs; values determined by explicit modulo fixture fields, not Magic rules
actions: Render/measure every object
Inspect/search and select the last offered instance
expected: Live values come from each projected object
No object cap or identity grouping

cases.purpose: Release historical animation poses while retaining all current objects
cases.initialState: 1000 projected objects replaced by new IDs in20waves
actions: Adopt20distinct1000-object fields
Draw each wave
Clear field and draw grace frames
expected: Retained pose count no more than3currentfields
No poses after clear; no native object cap

cases.purpose: Combine crowded board, long stack and readable log workloads
actions: Render and measure actual UI with stack/log open
Retain every native-shaped card ID
expected: No object or stack mutation
Bounded raster caches and no hang under configured budgets

cases.purpose: Inspect supplied merged components independently of host current values
cases.initialState: Gemrazer-shaped host current5/5, one+1/+1 counter, original Rat1/1 component and Gemrazer4/4 printing; controlled presentation only
actions: Run exact native-offered prompt controls
Open merged host details
Choose top component printing
expected: Host remains one permanent
Current5/5 and Printed4/4 stay distinct
No target/action for a component

cases.purpose: Render an independently captured actual native projection without relabeling it as native execution in the client
cases.initialState: Exact JSON snapshot supplied with --native, including all native object IDs and original/live metadata
actions: Load captured projection
Wait for legitimate opening-roll overlay to finish
Measure and capture battlefield
Inspect native mutate components if present
expected: Every native battlefield ID remains represented
No native actions or outcome invented by renderer

cases.purpose: Prove external watchdog owns and removes only its own stuck child, then continues
actions: Spawn owned sleeping child
Exceed0.2s wall budget
TERM thenKILL only the owned process group if necessary
Spawn following successful child
expected: Termination confirmed
Next child exits0
cases.reproduce: Every client runner invocation includes this self-test

cases.purpose: Follow native top-component/copy-source illustration identity while retaining host target ID, token flag and live values
cases.initialState: Controlled native-shaped merged/copy/token-template projections; optional captured native merged/copy hosts; owned catalog metadata and generated PNG pixels
actions: Request exact native visual-source metadata and local-only image path
Decode real generated PNG bytes through LÖVE Artwork.image
Inspect shared artwork status and unchanged native host
Reject hidden or unavailable top metadata without guessing another component
expected: Native merged/copied source selects its exact printing
Native host token/id/live values remain unchanged
